summary: The change replaces the origin allow-list with unconditional reflection of any origin while keeping `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true`. This combination is forbidden by the CORS specification: browsers ignore the `Allow-Origin` header (or treat it as invalid) when credentials are requested and the origin is `*` or an untrusted reflected value. Any authenticated cross-origin request from a webview or other client will now be blocked or silently stripped of credentials.
